testFuzz_sharesNeverExceedAssets(uint96).details: Holds because `previewDeposit` rounds shares down and `previewRedeem` rounds      assets down, so every rounding remainder is retained by the vault rather than      handed to the caller.

params.assets: Fuzzed deposit size (uint96 keeps it inside a realistic token supply).

failed().notice: Returns true if any test assertion has failed.

targetSenders().notice: Returns sender allowlist configured via `targetSender` (empty means no sender allowlist).

testFuzz_sharesNeverExceedAssets(uint96).notice: A deposit followed immediately by a full exit can never return more asset than         went in.

test_deposit_revertsWhenCapBreached().notice: A deposit that would push `totalAssets()` past the cap reverts with the custom         error, and one that lands exactly on the cap succeeds.

test_harvest_chargesFeeWhenNavAboveHighW.notice: `harvest()` charges the 20% fee when NAV per share rises above the HWM.

test_harvest_highWaterMarkNeverDecreases.notice: The high-water mark is monotonically non-decreasing across a full profit / loss         / recovery cycle.

test_harvest_skipsFeeWhenNavBelowHighWat.notice: `harvest()` charges nothing while NAV per share is below the high-water mark.
